// ========== COOKIE CONSENT ==========
(function() {
  var banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  var acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  var manageBtn = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  var declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  var modal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('cookieModalOverlay');
  var modalSave = document.getElementById('cookieModalSave');
  var modalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  var cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');
  var toggles = modal.querySelectorAll('.cookie-toggle');

  // Show banner on load
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (!localStorage.getItem('leap_cookies_consent')) {
      banner.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }, 1200);

  function closeBanner() {
    banner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  function openModal() {
    modal.classList.add('active');
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('active');
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'all');
    closeBanner();
  });

  declineBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    closeBanner();
  });

  manageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    openModal();
  });

  cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    openModal();
  });

  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  toggles.forEach(function(toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (toggle.dataset.cookie === 'essential') return;
      var isActive = toggle.classList.toggle('active');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(isActive));
    });
    toggle.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); toggle.click(); }
    });
  });

  modalSave.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var consent = ['essential'];
    toggles.forEach(function(t) { if (t.classList.contains('active')) consent.push(t.dataset.cookie); });
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', consent.join(','));
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });

  modalDecline.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    toggles.forEach(function(t) {
      if (t.dataset.cookie !== 'essential') {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
      }
    });
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });
})();


// ========== SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS ==========
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(anchor) {
  anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
    if (target) {
      e.preventDefault();
      target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  });
});
</script>

/* ========== UTILITIES ========== */
.container { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .container { padding: 0 40px; } }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .container { padding: 0 64px; } }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

/* ========== SKIP LINK ========== */
.skip-link {

/* ========== NAVIGATION ========== */

.nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }

/* Language Selector */
.lang-selector { position: relative; }
.lang-btn {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

.lang-btn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform var(--transition-fast); }

.lang-dropdown {

  min-width: 180px; background: var(--bg-card);

  padding: 6px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);

}
.lang-dropdown.active { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.lang-dropdown a {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;

  font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.lang-dropdown a.active { color: var(--accent-blue); }

/* Mobile menu toggle */

  function goToSlide(index) {
    slides[current].classList.remove('active');
    dots[current].classList.remove('active');
    dots[current].setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    current = (index + slides.length) % slides.length;

(function() {
  var banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  var acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  var manageBtn = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  var declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  var modal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('cookieModalOverlay');
  var modalSave = document.getElementById('cookieModalSave');
  var modalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  var cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');
  var toggles = modal.querySelectorAll('.cookie-toggle');

  // Show banner on load
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (!localStorage.getItem('leap_cookies_consent')) {
      banner.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }, 1200);

  function closeBanner() {
    banner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  function openModal() {
    modal.classList.add('active');
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('active');
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'all');
    closeBanner();
  });

  declineBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    closeBanner();
  });

  manageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    openModal();
  });

  cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    openModal();
  });

  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  toggles.forEach(function(toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (toggle.dataset.cookie === 'essential') return;
      var isActive = toggle.classList.toggle('active');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(isActive));
    });
    toggle.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); toggle.click(); }
    });
  });

  modalSave.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var consent = ['essential'];
    toggles.forEach(function(t) { if (t.classList.contains('active')) consent.push(t.dataset.cookie); });
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', consent.join(','));
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });

  modalDecline.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    toggles.forEach(function(t) {
      if (t.dataset.cookie !== 'essential') {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
      }
    });
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });
})();

  });

.cookie-banner {
  position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 2000;
  background: var(--bg-card); border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 20px 24px; transform: translateY(100%);
  transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}
.cookie-banner.visible { transform: translateY(0); }
.cookie-inner {
  max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .cookie-inner { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
}
.cookie-text { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; flex: 1; }
.cookie-text a { color: var(--accent-blue); text-decoration: underline; }
.cookie-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cookie-btn {
  padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cookie-btn-accept { background: var(--accent-blue); color: #fff; }
.cookie-btn-accept:hover { background: var(--accent-blue-hover); }
.cookie-btn-manage { border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.cookie-btn-manage:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); color: var(--text-primary); }
.cookie-btn-decline { border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); }
.cookie-btn-decline:hover { border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.4); color: #EF4444; }

/* Cookie Settings Modal */
.cookie-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2001;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: all var(--transition-base);
}
.cookie-modal-overlay.active { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.cookie-modal {
  position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; z-index: 2002;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.95);
  background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 32px;
  width: 90%; max-width: 520px; max-height: 80vh; overflow-y: auto;
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}
.cookie-modal.active { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
.cookie-modal h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.cookie-modal p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.cookie-option {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.cookie-option-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.cookie-option-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.cookie-toggle {
  width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--text-muted); position: relative;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast); cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.cookie-toggle.active { background: var(--accent-blue); }
.cookie-toggle::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px;
  width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff; transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}
.cookie-toggle.active::after { transform: translateX(20px); }
.cookie-modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 24px; justify-content: flex-end; }

/* ========== REDUCED MOTION ========== */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
}

/* ========== SCROLLBAR ========== */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 3px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
</style>

(function() {
  var banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  var acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  var manageBtn = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  var declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  var modal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('cookieModalOverlay');
  var modalSave = document.getElementById('cookieModalSave');
  var modalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  var cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');
  var toggles = modal.querySelectorAll('.cookie-toggle');

  // Show banner on load
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (!localStorage.getItem('leap_cookies_consent')) {
      banner.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }, 1200);

  function closeBanner() {
    banner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  function openModal() {
    modal.classList.add('active');
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('active');
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'all');
    closeBanner();
  });

  declineBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    closeBanner();
  });

  manageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    openModal();
  });

  cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    openModal();
  });

  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  toggles.forEach(function(toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (toggle.dataset.cookie === 'essential') return;
      var isActive = toggle.classList.toggle('active');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(isActive));
    });
    toggle.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); toggle.click(); }
    });
  });

  modalSave.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var consent = ['essential'];
    toggles.forEach(function(t) { if (t.classList.contains('active')) consent.push(t.dataset.cookie); });
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', consent.join(','));
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });

  modalDecline.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    toggles.forEach(function(t) {
      if (t.dataset.cookie !== 'essential') {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
      }
    });
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });
})();

// ========== HERO CAROUSEL ==========
(function() {
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('heroPrev');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('heroNext');
  let current = 0;
  let autoTimer = null;

  function goToSlide(index) {
    slides[current].classList.remove('active');
    dots[current].classList.remove('active');
    dots[current].setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    current = (index + slides.length) % slides.length;
    slides[current].classList.add('active');
    dots[current].classList.add('active');
    dots[current].setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    resetAutoTimer();
  }

  function resetAutoTimer() {
    clearInterval(autoTimer);
    autoTimer = setInterval(function() { goToSlide(current + 1); }, 6000);
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goToSlide(current - 1); });

(function() {
  var banner = document.getElementById('cookieBanner');
  var acceptBtn = document.getElementById('cookieAccept');
  var manageBtn = document.getElementById('cookieManage');
  var declineBtn = document.getElementById('cookieDecline');
  var modal = document.getElementById('cookieModal');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('cookieModalOverlay');
  var modalSave = document.getElementById('cookieModalSave');
  var modalDecline = document.getElementById('cookieModalDecline');
  var cookieSettingsLink = document.getElementById('cookieSettingsLink');
  var toggles = modal.querySelectorAll('.cookie-toggle');

  // Show banner on load
  setTimeout(function() {
    if (!localStorage.getItem('leap_cookies_consent')) {
      banner.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }, 1200);

  function closeBanner() {
    banner.classList.remove('visible');
  }

  function openModal() {
    modal.classList.add('active');
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('active');
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'all');
    closeBanner();
  });

  declineBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    closeBanner();
  });

  manageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    openModal();
  });

  cookieSettingsLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    openModal();
  });

  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  toggles.forEach(function(toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (toggle.dataset.cookie === 'essential') return;
      var isActive = toggle.classList.toggle('active');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(isActive));
    });
    toggle.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); toggle.click(); }
    });
  });

  modalSave.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var consent = ['essential'];
    toggles.forEach(function(t) { if (t.classList.contains('active')) consent.push(t.dataset.cookie); });
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', consent.join(','));
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });

  modalDecline.addEventListener('click', function() {
    localStorage.setItem('leap_cookies_consent', 'essential');
    toggles.forEach(function(t) {
      if (t.dataset.cookie !== 'essential') {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
      }
    });
    closeModal();
    closeBanner();
  });
})();

steps.message:
The Leap Studio landing page is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

**Design System:**
- Dark mode only (#0A0A0A background), with elevated surfaces (#111111, #161616)
- Inter font family (Google Fonts), bold/modern/elegant typography
- Electric blue (#3B82F6) primary accent, warm amber (#F59E0B) secondary accent
- CSS custom properties for all tokens, generous whitespace

**All 8 Sections (per task_input.json order):**
1. **Hero carousel** — 5 slides with auto-rotation (6s), dot navigation, prev/next arrows, pause-on-hover, keyboard support
2. **Team section** — Region tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) filtering team member cards with photo placeholders, quotes, titles, office locations, and contact CTAs
3. **Work showcase** — Horizontal-scrolling carousel with 8 project cards, client labels, testimonials, case study links
4. **CTA banner** — "Let's work together" with glow effect and "Get in touch" CTA
5. **How we work** — Split layout with decorative visual and "Advancing people and planet" content
6. **Latest insights** — 8-card responsive grid (1/2/3 columns) with podcast/article/report type badges
7. **Principles** — 4 principle cards with numbered indicators and accent border on hover
8. **Footer** — Two CTA cards, nav links, legal text

**Interactive Features:**
- Language selector dropdown (Global EN / France FR / China CN)
- Cookie consent banner with Accept / Manage Settings / Decline
- Cookie settings modal with toggle switches
- Mobile hamburger menu
- Smooth scroll anchor navigation

**Accessibility:** Skip link, ARIA labels/roles, focus-visible outlines, keyboard navigation, prefers-reduced-motion support, 4.5:1+ contrast ratios.
